## A Nutritious Meal in Minutes

Black Bean Avocado Wraps are the perfect solution for busy days when you need a nutritious meal that doesn't sacrifice flavor or satisfaction. Packed with plant-based protein from black beans, healthy fats from avocado, and a rainbow of vegetables, these wraps deliver a complete meal that's as good for your body as it is for your taste buds.

What makes these wraps special is the balance of textures and flavors – creamy avocado, hearty beans, crunchy fresh vegetables, and bright citrus notes from the lime juice. The gentle warming of spices adds depth without overwhelming heat, though you can certainly adjust to your preference with additional cayenne or hot sauce.

These wraps are endlessly customizable based on what you have on hand, making them a perfect clean-out-the-fridge meal that still feels intentional and delicious.

## The Art of Wrapping

Creating the perfect wrap is a skill worth mastering for quick meals that travel well. Here are some tips to ensure your wraps stay intact and delicious:

- **Warm the tortillas**: This makes them more pliable and less likely to crack when folded
- **Create a barrier**: The mashed avocado spread acts as a barrier between the tortilla and wetter ingredients, preventing sogginess
- **Don't overfill**: It's tempting to pile on the filling, but an overstuffed wrap will burst at the seams
- **Tight rolling technique**: Tuck in the sides first, then roll from the bottom up, keeping tension as you go
- **Secure if needed**: If taking to-go, secure with parchment paper, foil, or even a toothpick
- **Toast to seal**: A quick toast in a dry skillet helps seal the wrap and adds a pleasant textural contrast

Remember that the sequence of layering matters – placing sturdy ingredients next to the tortilla helps protect it from tearing when you bite into your wrap.

## Building Flavor Profiles

The basic recipe provides a Mexican-inspired flavor profile, but you can easily adapt these wraps to feature different cuisine styles:

- **Mediterranean**: Use hummus instead of mashed avocado, add cucumber, olives, and feta cheese, and season with za'atar instead of cumin and chili powder
- **Asian-Inspired**: Add thinly sliced cabbage, carrots, and edamame, and season with soy sauce, sesame oil, and a touch of ginger
- **California-Style**: Include sprouts, grated carrots, and cucumber with a tahini-lemon dressing
- **Southwestern**: Add roasted sweet potatoes, pickled jalapeños, and a sprinkle of cheddar cheese

## Variations

### Rainbow Veggie Wraps
Go heavy on the colorful vegetables by adding grated carrots, purple cabbage, yellow squash, and cucumber for a wrap that's as beautiful as it is nutritious.

### Breakfast Wraps
Transform this into a morning meal by adding scrambled eggs or tofu alongside the black bean mixture and topping with salsa.

### Burrito Bowl
Deconstruct the wrap into a bowl format by serving the fillings over a bed of rice or cauliflower rice for a hearty fork-friendly meal.

# General Tso's chicken

![General Tso's chicken](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/C7EgpQ_VsAAyvuA.jpg)

> Needs to be spicier, and could use more depth of flavor.

## Sauce

Combine in a small bowl:

- 1 tablespoon double-concentrate **tomato paste**, mixed with 1 tablespoon water
- 1 tablespoon of water
- 1/2 teaspoon **potato flour** (or cornstarch)
- 1/2 teaspoon **dark soy sauce**
- 1.5 teaspoons **light soy sauce**
- 1 tablespoon **rice vinegar**
- 3 tablespoons **chicken stock** (or water)

## Chicken

Combine in a large bowl:

- 12 ounces (about 4 to 5) **skinless, boneless chicken thighs**, sinew removed, crosshatched, cut into bite-sized pieces
- 1/2 teaspoon **dark soy sauce**
- 2 teaspoons **light soy sauce**
- 1 egg yolk

Add (use extra oil to avoid clumps):

- 2 tablespoons **potato flour**
- 2 teaspoons **peanut oil**

Set aside to marinade (at least 15 minutes).

## Rice

Bring to a simmer:

- 1 cup **short or medium grain white rice**, rinsed thoroughly
- 1.5 cups water

Reduce heat to low and cover for 20 minutes.

Remove from heat and let steam for 10 minutes.

Fold gently to fluff. Can be held for up to an hour.

## Deep frying

Fill a wok with 1.5 inches oil and heat to 350-400 F:

- **Peanut oil** (up to a quart)

Working in two batches, stir fry until crip and deep gold (~3 minutes):

- Chicken

Transfer to a plate.

Discard or set aside peanut oil, and wipe the wok clean.

## Stir frying

Over high heat:

- 2 tablespoons **peanut oil**

Stir fry until they start to change color (~15 seconds):

- 6 to 10 **dried red chilies**, cut into 3/4-inch pieces, discarding seeds

Stir-fry until fragrant (~30 seconds):

- 6 grams peeled **ginger**, finely chopped (about 2 teaspoons)
- 3 cloves garlic, minced

Stir constantly until thickened:

- Sauce

Add and stir to coat:

- Fried chicken

Remove from heat. Garnish:

- 2 teaspoons **sesame oil**
- 2 **green onions**, thinly sliced, for garnish

Serve immediately with:

- Rice

Chocolate Chip Cookies (GAPS Approved, Gluten-Free, Paleo)

Author Caroline

Ingredients

-   1 ¾ cup almond flour
-   ¼ cup maple syrup or honey
-   ¾ cup homemade chocolate chips (use this recipe, non-GAPSters can
    use Enjoy Life Chocolate Chips)
-   ¼ cup butter or coconut oil (softened)
-   ¼ tsp unrefined sea salt (where to buy sea salt)
-   ¼ tsp baking soda
-   1 tsp vanilla

Instructions

1.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2.  Line cookie sheet with unbleached parchment paper.
3.  Mix all ingredients together in one bowl (except chocolate chips).
4.  Add in chocolate chips.
5.  Scoop out 1 tablespoon cookie dough with a spoon (I use a measuring
    spoon) and place on the prepared cookie sheet. Keep 3 inches of
    space between each cookie. Press down slightly to flatten the
    cookie.
6.  Bake for 6-10 minutes. The cookie should just be a little golden
    brown on the bottom. _Do not over cook!_
7.  Cool for 10 minutes on the cookie sheet (or else they will be too
    soft to pick up). These cookies should stay soft when cool.
8.  Eat with a smile! Yum 🙂

Notes

*Store leftovers in a container for 1 week or the fridge for a few
weeks.*Store left over cookie dough in the fridge for 2 weeks or the
freezer for a few months!

# 阳朔啤酒鱼的做法

![阳朔啤酒鱼成品](./阳朔啤酒鱼.png)
![阳朔啤酒鱼参考图](./阳朔啤酒鱼参考.jpg)

阳朔啤酒鱼是广西阳朔的地方名菜，选用漓江鲜鱼带鳞煎制，以啤酒代水焖煮，鱼鳞酥脆、鱼肉鲜嫩，啤酒香与番茄微酸交融，风味浓郁独特。鱼肉富含优质蛋白和矿物质，搭配番茄、辣椒，维生素丰富且开胃助食。制作难度中等，对新手稍具挑战，但跟着步骤操作也能成功，预计 30 分钟即可完成。

预估烹饪难度：★★★

预估卡路里：1092 大卡

## 必备原料和工具

- 剑骨鱼或鲤鱼（约 1.5 斤，让店家处理内脏，但**不要刮鱼鳞**）
- 漓泉啤酒（一瓶，约 330ml，桂林本地啤酒，最正宗）
- 番茄（2 个）
- 青椒（2 个）
- 红椒（1 个）
- 大蒜（5-6 瓣）
- 生姜（1 块）
- 葱（2 根）
- 桂林辣椒酱
- 料酒
- 生抽
- 老抽
- 白糖
- 食盐
- 食用油

## 计算

每份：

- 剑骨鱼或鲤鱼 1 条（约 750g，不去鳞）
- 料酒 15ml
- 漓泉啤酒 330ml（1 瓶）
- 番茄 2 个（约 300g）
- 青椒 2 个（约 150g）
- 红椒 1 个（约 80g）
- 大蒜 6 瓣（约 30g）
- 生姜 1 块（约 20g）
- 葱 2 根（约 40g）
- 桂林辣椒酱 15g
- 生抽 15ml
- 老抽 5ml
- 白糖 5g
- 食盐 5g
- 食用油 30ml

## 操作

1. 鱼处理好内脏，保留鱼鳞，清洗干净，从腹部剖开成两半（背部相连），用 15ml 料酒、姜片、食盐 3g 腌制 15 分钟
2. 番茄切块，青椒红椒切块，大蒜拍碎，生姜切片，葱切段（葱白葱叶分开）
3. 用姜片擦拭锅底，热锅后倒入 30ml 食用油，油热后放入鱼（鱼皮朝下），煎至两面金黄、鱼鳞酥脆，盛出备用
4. 锅中留底油，放入葱白、姜片、蒜瓣爆香
5. 加入 15g 桂林辣椒酱，炒出红油
6. 放入番茄块，翻炒至番茄出汁变软
7. 倒入整瓶啤酒，加入 15ml 生抽、5ml 老抽、5g 白糖、5g 食盐，搅拌均匀
8. 放入煎好的鱼，大火烧开后转中小火，盖上锅盖焖煮 15-20 分钟
9. 开盖，放入青椒红椒块，继续煮 3-5 分钟
10. 大火收汁至汤汁浓稠，撒上葱叶段，出锅装盘

## 附加内容

- 鱼鳞是这道菜的关键特色，一定要保留，煎炸后会变得酥脆可口
- 鱼剖成两半更容易煎透入味，比整条划刀效果更好
- 正宗做法使用桂林辣椒酱（非郫县豆瓣酱），搭配漓泉啤酒，没有桂林辣椒酱可以用蒜蓉辣酱代替
- 番茄要炒软出汁，这样汤汁更浓郁
- 汤汁不要收太干，留一些拌饭或拌面非常好吃
- 参考资料：[阳朔啤酒鱼的做法](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1rt4y1976z)

# 老妈蹄花的做法

![result 3](./result3.jpg)

老妈蹄花汤色奶白，猪蹄软烂脱骨，口感细腻，配上酸辣蘸汁十分开胃，是经典的川式家常菜。猪蹄富含胶原蛋白，白芸豆增添绵密口感，营养丰富。操作需要高压锅和提前浸泡，对新手有一定挑战，但按步骤来做不难掌握。含浸泡和压煮，全程大约需要 2 小时（不含提前一晚浸泡白芸豆的时间）。

预估烹饪难度：★★★★

预估卡路里：1425 大卡

## 必备原料和工具

- 猪蹄（尽量选择猪前蹄：肉多筋多骨头少）
- 葱
- 姜
- 料酒
- 生抽
- 白芷
- 当归（可选）
- 鸡精
- 盐
- 蒜
- 小米椒
- 白胡椒粉
- 生抽
- 香醋
- 花椒油
- 油泼辣子（可选）
- 白芸豆（没有可用海带）

## 计算

- 猪蹄：3 根
- 白芸豆：200g
- 当归：2g
- 白胡椒粉：5g
- 姜片：30g
- 当归：2g
- 蒜末：8g
- 鸡精：2g
- 生抽：25g
- 葱花：10g

## 操作

### 开始制作

1. 200g 白芸豆提前一晚清水浸泡备用
2. 准备猪前蹄，买菜的时候让师傅从中间劈开，用喷火枪去除毛囊，拿回家清洗
3. 冷水锅中加入猪蹄、大葱段、姜片、料酒，焯水十分钟，撇去浮沫，捞出洗干净备用
4. 高压锅中放入猪蹄、当归、白芷、白胡椒粉、姜片，上汽后压三十分钟，放入白芸豆，再压十分钟，这个时候如果汤底是奶白色，那么恭喜是正确的（如果中途需要加水，只能加热水）

![老妈蹄花-预览图-2](./result1.jpg)

5. 揭盖后加入盐、鸡精、葱花调味
6. 调制灵魂汁子：放入葱、蒜、小米椒，白胡椒粉、生抽、香醋、油泼辣子、花椒油、猪蹄原汤
  ![老妈蹄花-预览图-3](./result2.jpg)
7. 灵魂汁子，浇给

This is the best chocolate chip cookie recipe! Soft baked, very chocolatey and impossible to ruin. All chocolate chip cookies should be this good!

[chocolate chip cookie recipe]

[]

I am in love with these cookies.

After googling and searching and researching and testing (yum!) I’ve
figured out the perfect combination of ingredients and baking methods to
get super soft and chewy cookies.

[]MY LATEST VIDEOS

I hate making and eating crispy cookies. I think they should be illegal,
plus, who wants to eat those? What a waste of calories.

ANYWAYS, after a lot of trial and error, here is what I’ve discovered
whilst creating super soft cookies:

Tips for making Perfect Chocolate Chip Cookies

-   Use melted butter. (I never have time to let butter come to room
    temperature! I don’t ever think of it. Problem solved with melted
    butter!)
-   Use two kinds of sugars. (For a little color and softness)
-   Use an egg and an egg yolk. (Extra creamy!)
-   Use two kinds of chocolate chips. (My husband loves milk, I love
    semi sweet…this is our compromise)
-   Let the dough sit 20 minutes for the flour to absorb into the rest
    of the dough. (So they don’t spread all over)
-   Bake cookies at 325. (Helps keep them soft!)
-   Use light colored baking sheets. (Helps the cookie edges stay soft
    and bake evenly)
-   Cool cookies on hot baking sheet. (Finish baking on the hot cookie
    sheet outside of the oven!)

[best chocolate chip cookie recipe]

So, if you read the recipe through, you’ll notice the differences listed
above. I suppose there are a lot of similarities too, but the small and
minor tweaks are what set this recipe apart!

[best chocolate chip cookies]

[chocolate chip cookies]

[chocolate chip cookie recipe]

If you love soft chocolate chip cookies, you MUST give this recipe a
try!! It will blow your minds.

[]

6 votes

Print


Actually Perfect Chocolate Chip Cookies

Prep 30 mins

Cook 9 mins

Total 39 mins

Author Lauren Brennan

Yield 36 cookies

This is the best chocolate chip cookie recipe! Soft baked, very
chocolatey and impossible to ruin. All chocolate chip cookies should be
this good!

Ingredients

-   3/4 cup butter, melted
-   1 cup packed brown sugar
-   1/2 cup granulated sugar
-   1 large egg + 1 egg yolk
-   2 teaspoons vanilla
-   2 cups all purpose flour
-   1/2 teaspoon baking soda
-   1/2 teaspoon salt
-   1 cup semi sweet chocolate chips
-   1 cup milk chocolate chips

Instructions

1.  Stir melted butter, brown sugar and granulated sugar until well
    combined.
2.  Add in egg, egg yolk and vanilla. Mix until lighter in color.
3.  Add in the flour, baking soda and salt. Scrape the sides of the bowl
    and the bottom really well to ensure a smooth, well stirred batter.
4.  Hand stir the chocolate chips into the batter and let it sit 20
    minutes to let the flour soak into the rest of the batter. (The warm
    melted butter will help with this.)
5.  Preheat oven to 325. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper and
    scoop cookie dough onto prepared pans, using a two tablespoon cookie
    scoop.
6.  Bake 8-9 minutes, rotating sheets half way through baking. When you
    pull your cookies out of the oven, they will looked cooked around
    the edges and undercooked in the center.
7.  Leave the cookies on the hot baking pans for 5-7 minutes or until
    you can remove them without falling apart. Place onto cooling racks
    and cool to room temperature before storing in air tight containers.

raw_text:
# 奶茶的做法

这是一道用红茶和奶粉轻松调制的家常饮品，茶香与奶香交融，口感顺滑温暖。红茶中的茶多酚搭配牛奶的蛋白质和钙质，既能提神又补充日常营养。做法非常简单，新手也能一次成功，仅需大约半 小时就能喝上自制奶茶。

预估烹饪难度：★★

预估卡路里：81 大卡

## 必备原料和工具

- 袋泡红茶（推荐立顿黄牌精选红茶）
- 全脂奶粉或淡奶
- 杯子，例如带刻度的杯子，陶瓷杯或保温杯

## 计算

每份：

- 袋泡红茶 2 包（约 4g）
- 奶粉 11-12g
- 砂糖 5-7g

## 操作

1. 取袋泡红茶 2 包放入杯中，加入 180-200mL **沸水**。
2. **等待 20 - 30 分钟**。
3. 称取 11-12g 奶粉和 5-7g 砂糖，分别加入前一步骤得到的液体中。
4. 搅拌均匀即可饮用。

## 附加内容

- 加入沸水后，尽量保持杯子内部温暖，例如使用开口较小的杯子或盖上盖子。如果气温较低时，使用量杯量取可能导致沸水在冲入红茶前冷却，则可以不使用量杯量取而直接估计其体积。
- 等待时间结束后可提起或搅动茶包以使冲泡更加均匀。

Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. If using radish greens, cut from bunches, wash thoroughly in cool water, and spin dry in a salad spinner.
Add a small amount of olive oil to a large ovenproof skillet and heat over medium-high heat. Arrange radishes cut side down and cook until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.
Transfer skillet to oven and roast until radishes are nicely browned and starting to get tender, about 10 minutes.
Add radish greens and roast until radishes are fully tender and greens have wilted, another 5 minutes.

Remove from oven and place skillet over low heat on stovetop (handle will be hot!). Season with salt, pepper, and ½ teaspoon chile flakes. Add butter and cook until melted, golden brown, and nutty smelling, 2-3 minutes.
Add vinegar and gently fold to combine. Drizzle with honey and fold again. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt, pepper, chile flakes, vinegar, or honey. Serve warm.

---
title: Roasted Radishes w/ Brown Butter, Chile, & Honey
description: A twist on the classic pairing of raw radishes and fresh butter. This dish transforms humble radishes through roasting until they become tender and sweet, then finishes them with nutty brown butter, tangy vinegar, warm chile, and golden honey. The result is an unexpectedly satisfying side dish with complex flavors that create a delicious tension between sweet, spicy, and savory.
date: 2023-05-15
imgSrc: /assets/img/roasted-radishes.jpg
imgAlt: Roasted Radishes w/ Brown Butter, Chile, & Honey
prepTime: 15 min
readyTime: 35 min
servings: 4-6
tags:
  - Gluten-Free
  - Healthy
  - Vegetable
  - Vegetarian
ingredients:
  - Extra-virgin olive oil
  - 2 bunches radishes, with their tops if fresh, halved lengthwise if large
  - Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
  - Dried chile flakes
  - 2 tbsp unsalted butter
  - 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
  - 2 tbsp honey
instructions:
  - Heat oven to 375°F. If using radish greens, cut from bunches, wash thoroughly in cool water, and spin dry in a salad spinner.
  - Add a small amount of olive oil to a large ovenproof skillet and heat over medium-high heat. Arrange radishes cut side down and cook until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.
  - Transfer skillet to oven and roast until radishes are nicely browned and starting to get tender, about 10 minutes.
  - Add radish greens and roast until radishes are fully tender and greens have wilted, another 5 minutes.
  - Remove from oven and place skillet over low heat on stovetop (handle will be hot!). Season with salt, pepper, and ½ teaspoon chile flakes. Add butter and cook until melted, golden brown, and nutty smelling, 2-3 minutes.
  - Add vinegar and gently fold to combine. Drizzle with honey and fold again. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt, pepper, chile flakes, vinegar, or honey. Serve warm.
notes:
  - A twist on the classic pairing of raw radishes and fresh butter.
  - Creates a delicious tension between sweet, spicy, and savory flavors.
  - Keep radish tops if they're fresh for added color and flavor.
---

## The Unexpected Delight of Roasted Radishes

Radishes are often relegated to the role of salad garnish or crudité platter component, valued more for their crisp texture and peppery bite than celebrated as a star ingredient. This recipe turns that notion on its head by roasting radishes, a cooking method that transforms these humble root vegetables into something altogether different and utterly delicious.

The magic happens when radishes meet high heat in the oven – their characteristic sharpness mellows dramatically, revealing a surprising sweetness that most people never knew existed. Their texture shifts from crisp and watery to tender and almost potato-like, while maintaining enough structure to avoid becoming mushy.

When paired with the nutty complexity of brown butter and the bright acidity of lemon, roasted radishes become an elegant side dish worthy of special occasions yet simple enough for everyday meals. This preparation method might just convince even the most dedicated radish skeptics to give these colorful roots another chance.

## The Science Behind the Transformation

The dramatic change in radishes when roasted can be explained through simple food science:

- **Heat breaks down isothiocyanates**: These compounds are responsible for the peppery bite in raw radishes
- **Caramelization occurs**: The natural sugars in radishes caramelize when exposed to high heat, enhancing their sweetness
- **Moisture reduction**: Roasting evaporates some of the water content, concentrating flavor and changing texture
- **Brown butter chemistry**: The milk solids in butter undergo Maillard reactions when browned, creating complex nutty flavors that complement the sweetened radishes

Understanding these processes helps explain why people who might not enjoy raw radishes often find the roasted version delightful – they're essentially experiencing a different vegetable altogether.

## Pairing and Serving Suggestions

This versatile side dish complements a wide variety of main courses:

- **Poultry**: Serve alongside roasted chicken or turkey
- **Fish**: Pair with a simply prepared white fish like halibut or cod
- **Beef**: The richness of steak or roast beef is balanced by the radishes' subtle sweetness
- **Vegetarian mains**: Complement grain bowls, risotto, or bean dishes

For a complete spring meal, serve these roasted radishes with a herb-roasted chicken, steamed asparagus, and crusty bread to soak up any remaining brown butter sauce.

## Seasonal Variations

While this recipe shines with spring radishes, it can be adapted throughout the year:

- **Spring**: Use tender young radishes with pink or purple exteriors
- **Summer**: Try larger summer radishes, which may need slightly longer cooking time
- **Fall**: Incorporate other root vegetables like turnips or parsnips
- **Winter**: Use black radishes or daikon, cut into larger pieces

## Creative Variations

### Honey Balsamic Roasted Radishes
Replace the brown butter with a mixture of 1 tablespoon honey and 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, tossed with the radishes after roasting.

### Herb-Crusted Radishes
Before roasting, toss the radishes with 2 tablespoons of finely chopped mixed herbs (rosemary, thyme, and sage) along with the olive oil.

### Spicy Roasted Radishes
Add 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes and 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika to the olive oil mixture before roasting for a hint of heat.

### Miso Butter Radishes
Replace the brown butter with a mixture of 2 tablespoons softened butter blended with 1 tablespoon white miso paste, melted and drizzled over the roasted radishes for an umami-rich variation.

instructions: In a large bowl, beat butter and sugars until blended. Beat in eggs and
vanilla. In a small bowl, whisk flour, baking soda and salt; gradually
beat into butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts.
Shape 1/4 cupfuls of dough into balls. Flatten each to 3/4-in.
thickness (2-1/2-in. diameter), smoothing edges as necessary. Place in
an airtight container, separating layers with waxed or parchment paper;
refrigerate, covered, overnight.
To bake, place dough portions 2 in. apart on parchment paper-lined
baking sheets; let stand at room temperature 30 minutes before baking.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Bake 10-12 minutes or until edges are golden brown (centers will be
light). Cool on pans 2 minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool. Yield:
about 2 dozen.
Editor's Note: To toast nuts, bake in a shallow pan in a 350° oven for
5-10 minutes or cook in a skillet over low heat until lightly browned,
stirring occasionally.

gradually beat into butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and

thickness (2-1/2-in. diameter), smoothing edges as necessary. Place

[Publisher Photo]

My take on the classic cookie is inspired by a bakery in California
called Hungry Bear. It's big, thick and chewy—truly the best chocolate
chip cookie recipe. —Irene Yeh, Mequon, Wisconsin

Featured In: 23 Recipes for Classroom Treats

MAKES:

24 servings

TOTAL TIME:

Prep: 35 min. + chilling Bake: 10 min./batch

TOTAL TIME:

Prep: 35 min. + chilling Bake: 10 min./batch

Ingredients

-   1 cup butter, softened
-   1 cup packed brown sugar
-   3/4 cup sugar
-   2 large eggs
-   1-1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
-   2-2/3 cups all-purpose flour
-   1-1/4 teaspoons baking soda
-   1 teaspoon salt
-   1 package (12 ounces) semisweet chocolate chips
-   2 cups coarsely chopped walnuts, toasted

Directions

In a large bowl, beat butter and sugars until blended. Beat in eggs and
vanilla. In a small bowl, whisk flour, baking soda and salt; gradually
beat into butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts.

 Shape 1/4 cupfuls of dough into balls. Flatten each to 3/4-in.
thickness (2-1/2-in. diameter), smoothing edges as necessary. Place in
an airtight container, separating layers with waxed or parchment paper;
refrigerate, covered, overnight.

 To bake, place dough portions 2 in. apart on parchment paper-lined
baking sheets; let stand at room temperature 30 minutes before baking.
Preheat oven to 400°.

 Bake 10-12 minutes or until edges are golden brown (centers will be
light). Cool on pans 2 minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool. Yield:
about 2 dozen.

Editor's Note: To toast nuts, bake in a shallow pan in a 350° oven for
5-10 minutes or cook in a skillet over low heat until lightly browned,
stirring occasionally.

Home June/July 2012, p41

1 cookie: 311 calories, 19g fat (8g saturated fat), 38mg cholesterol,
229mg sodium, 35g carbohydrate (23g sugars, 2g fiber), 4g protein.

Chilaquiles
===========

Place in a 250 degree oven, until they begin to dry (about 5 minutes):

- 3 corn tortillas

Slice the tortillas into strips (approximately 1cm x 2cm).

In a skillet, fry until slightly browned:

- Tortilla strips
- 2 tablespoons canola oil

Remove tortilla strips when well browned. Dry over a paper towel, and season with kosher salt.

In the same pan, adding extra oil if necessary, lightly brown:

- 1/4 pound ham steak, diced

When ham is nearly ready, add and saute until translucent:

- 2 tablespoons yellow onions, diced

Transfer to a non-stick pan:

- Ham and onions
- 2 heaping tablespoons chunky salsa (such as Mark's Good Stuff)

Cook over medium heat until salsa just begins to dry up. Add and lower heat:

- 6 eggs

When whites are starting to solidify, break yolks, add the following, and fold it all together:

- 1 heaping tablespoon chunky salsa
- Tortilla strips
- 2 ounces sharp cheddar, chopped

Plate immediately, and garnish each serving with:

- 1 heaping tablespoon chunky salsa
- Avocado, sliced
- Cilantro, coarsely chopped

Serve with:

- Flour tortillas
- Refried beans

title: Brown Butter
description: Transform ordinary butter into a fragrant, nutty culinary powerhouse with this simple technique. Brown butter adds incredible depth and complexity to crepes, pancakes, fish dishes, vegetable soups, and more. The golden, toasted milk solids create an irresistible aroma and rich flavor that elevates any dish from good to extraordinary.
date: 2023-05-15
imgSrc: /assets/img/brown-butter.jpg
imgAlt: Brown Butter
prepTime: 5 min
readyTime: 10 min
servings: Any amount
tags:
  - Breakfast
  - Condiments
  - Gluten-Free
  - Quick
  - Seafood
  - Vegetable
  - Vegetarian
ingredients:
  - Unsalted butter (any amount)
instructions:
  - Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Continue cooking while swirling the pan every few seconds.
  - Keep cooking until all water has evaporated, the milk solids on the bottom turn deep golden brown, and the butter smells fragrant, about 3 to 5 minutes (timing depends on amount and pan size).
  - Immediately pour into another container to stop the cooking process. Include the toasted milk solids for maximum flavor, unless using as a cooking fat where solids might burn.
  - Use immediately or store for later. Perfect for drizzling over fish, vegetables, or incorporating into pancakes and crepes.
notes:
  - Watch carefully to prevent burning - the butter can go from perfect to burnt very quickly.
  - The butter is ready when it smells nutty and the milk solids are golden brown.
  - Brown butter can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one week.
---

## The Magic of Brown Butter

Brown butter is one of those culinary techniques that demonstrates how transformative cooking can be. Through a simple process of heating and caramelizing the milk solids in butter, you create something entirely new – a sauce with complex, nutty flavors and an intoxicating aroma that bears little resemblance to its original state.

The magic happens as the milk solids separate from the butterfat and sink to the bottom of the pan, where they caramelize into tiny golden-brown particles. Meanwhile, the water content evaporates, concentrating the flavor. The result is a rich, nutty essence that French chefs call "beurre noisette" (hazelnut butter) because of its distinctive color and aroma.

## Understanding the Process

The transformation of butter to brown butter happens in several distinct stages:

1. **Melting**: The butter liquefies but remains yellow and clear
2. **Foaming**: Water in the butter begins to evaporate, creating foam on the surface
3. **Clearing**: The foam subsides and you can see the milk solids beginning to separate
4. **Browning**: The milk solids toast and caramelize, turning golden-brown
5. **Completion**: The butter takes on an amber color with a nutty aroma

The key to perfect brown butter is recognizing exactly when to remove it from the heat – after the milk solids have browned but before they burn and become bitter.

## Culinary Uses

Brown butter's versatility makes it a secret weapon in the kitchen:

- **Pasta Enhancer**: Toss with ravioli or gnocchi with sage leaves and Parmesan
- **Fish Finisher**: Drizzle over white fish like sole, cod, or halibut
- **Vegetable Elevater**: Pour over steamed vegetables, especially cauliflower or winter squash
- **Baking Secret**: Substitute for regular butter in cookies, cakes, or frosting for deeper flavor
- **Breakfast Upgrade**: Drizzle over pancakes, waffles, or French toast
- **Sauce Base**: Use as a starting point for more complex pan sauces
- **Bread Dipper**: Serve warm with fresh bread as an alternative to olive oil

## Variations

### Brown Butter Sage Sauce
Add 10-12 fresh sage leaves to the butter during the last minute of browning. The leaves will crisp and the sage flavor will infuse the butter.

### Lemon Brown Butter
After removing from heat, add 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice and 1 teaspoon lemon zest for a bright, acidic counterpoint.

### Sweet Brown Butter

# 杨枝甘露的做法

这是一道改良版的经典港式甜品，用奇亚籽代替西谷米，口感滑嫩又带有籽粒的细微嚼劲，芒果的香甜与葡萄柚的微酸交织，椰奶增添浓郁。富含膳食纤维、维生素 C 和优质脂肪，清爽解暑。制作非常简单，新手也能轻松完成，从备料到享用只需约 20 分钟。

预估烹饪难度：★★

预估卡路里：661 大卡

## 必备原料和工具

- 杯子
- 水果刀
- 牛奶
- 冰块
- 调理机/果汁机

## 计算

每份：

- 奇亚籽 24g
- 牛奶 50ml
- 冰块 2 小块
- 芒果 1 粒
- 葡萄柚 1/2 粒
- 椰奶 150ml

点缀:

- 切丝芒果干 （可选）
- 切丝柳橙干 （可选）

## 操作

1. 奇亚籽泡牛奶 10 分钟。
2. 泡籽之时，把半粒芒果、葡萄柚去皮切丁，放入杯中。
3. 半粒芒果切小块放入调理机加冰块、椰奶打成泥。
4. 倒入杯中，放上点缀材料（如有）。
5. 一边享用一边写代码！！

# 巴基斯坦牛肉咖喱的做法

![巴基斯坦牛肉咖喱成品](./巴基斯坦牛肉咖喱.png)

这道巴基斯坦风味咖喱牛肉香浓软糯，酸辣开胃，带着浓郁的香料气息。牛肉提供优质蛋白，搭配番茄和酸奶，营养均衡。做法不算繁琐，但慢炖需要一点耐心，很适合在闲暇的周末从容准备。从头到尾大约两个半小时，就能端出一锅温暖的异国美味。

预估烹饪难度：★★★★★

预估卡路里：602 大卡

## 必备原料和工具

- 普通的炒锅
- 电饭煲/电炖锅
- Masala 粉（品牌可选 Shan）
- 牛肉
- 番茄
- 螺丝椒
- 原味酸奶
- 蒜粉
- 姜粉

## 计算

这里以 1kg 牛肉的所需要的配菜量作为标的，可以通过它计算出不同菜量。1kg 牛肉做出的咖喱大概够 5 个人吃。

1kg 牛肉所需要的配菜量：

- 番茄🍅 4 个
- 螺丝椒 2 个（大个的）
- 原味酸奶 1 盒
- Masala 粉一包 50g
- 蒜粉 5g
- 姜粉 5g

## 操作

1. 全部螺丝椒切成段状，备用
2. 全部番茄打成番茄蓉，备用
![番茄蓉](./番茄蓉.png)
3. 牛肉切成 2cm 的小块，洗净备用
![牛肉](./牛肉.png)
4. 炒锅中倒入一层油（用来防止番茄蓉沸腾蒸发）
![油](./油.png)
5. 倒入番茄蓉，持续搅拌 2-3 分钟，等待它越变越红
![倒入番茄蓉](./倒入番茄蓉.png)
![红](./红.png)
6. 加入 5g 蒜粉，5g 姜粉和 1 包 50g 的 Masala 粉，搅拌均匀
7. 加入牛肉和螺丝椒段，搅拌均匀
8. 加入 1 盒酸奶（为了让整个酱汁变得粘稠），搅拌均匀
9. 将整锅材料转移到电饭煲/电炖锅，并加入 250 ml 的水，开启炖肉/慢炖档，设定时间 2-3 个小时
10. 等待完成，开锅检查牛肉软糯，就可以吃了
![巴基斯坦牛肉咖喱成品](./巴基斯坦牛肉咖喱.png)

这道菜是从一个巴基斯坦的朋友那里偷师而来，特地整理了笔记，绝对正宗。

通常配以 烙饼(roti)、馕(naan) 或 米饭 食用。

如果想做 Chicken karahi 流程几乎是一样的，除了是先用油和各种花椒胡椒煎鸡肉变黄。

# 茭白炒肉的做法

茭白炒肉是一道家常快手菜，口感鲜嫩爽脆，咸鲜适口，属于典型的江南家常风味。茭白富含膳食纤维和多种维生素，搭配瘦肉提供优质蛋白，荤素搭配均衡营养。烹饪难度中等，新手稍加练习即可掌握，预计制作时长约 20 分钟。

预估烹饪难度：★★★

预估卡路里：515 大卡

## 必备原料和工具

* 茭白
* 瘦肉
* 淀粉
* 食用油
* 鸡精
* 姜
* 蒜
* 料酒
* 盐

## 计算

每份：

* 茭白 2 根
* 瘦肉 100 g
* 淀粉 15 g
* 食用油 30 ml
* 鸡精 5 g
* 姜 1 片
* 蒜 1 个
* 料酒 5 ml
* 盐 2 g

## 操作

### 准备

1. 茭白切片，每片厚度 0.5 cm
2. 瘦肉切条，厚度 0.3-0.5 cm，加入料酒、生粉、盐、水搅拌
3. 姜切片、蒜头剁碎

### 制作

1. 起锅水烧开，放入茭白，水煮 60-90 S 后取出沥干
2. 起锅，倒入 15 ml 油，倒入瘦肉，反复翻炒 60 S 取出
3. 起锅，倒入 15 ml 油，倒入姜、蒜翻炒 30S，加入茭白继续翻炒 30 S
4. 继续加入瘦肉翻炒 60 S，加入 20 ml 水，加入盐、鸡精后翻炒 60S 出锅

![茭白炒肉-预览图-1](./1.jpeg)
![茭白炒肉-预览图-2](./2.jpeg)

## 附加内容

* 最后一个步骤，可以考虑加蚝油、生抽代替盐上色

Triple Chocolate Cookies

by The Pioneer Woman on February 1, 2016

-   

-    share
-    tweet
-    pin
-

[]_(Note: I have altered the amount of flour in the recipe below based
on feedback!)_

We had boys, boys, boys, boys, boys, and boys at our house after church
yesterday and I don’t know why I forget just how much food boys consume
when they’re together in a pack, but they pretty much wiped me out. Then
I made a big batch of the most chocolaty cookies I’ve ever eaten…

And they pretty much wiped me out of those, too. Which was probably just
as well, considering I’m trying to be a good girl these days.

And actually, I’m not trying to be a good girl at all. But that’s
another story for another time.

These are just like my Chocolate Chocolate White Chocolate Chip Cookies,
but they’re all chocolate, all the time. There’s absolutely no respite
from the chocolate with these cookies…and of course, that’s just the
kind of situation a chocoholic wants to be in.

 
[]Start with butter and sugar…

 
 
[]Wait. It’s Monday. Let’s just take a moment to enjoy this beautiful
sight.

_Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh._

 
 
[]Beat it together until it’s totes combined.

 
 
[]Crack in an egg…

 
 
[]And mix it in, scraping the bowl when it’s incorporated.

 
 
[]Then add the other egg and do the same thing!

 
 
[]Add vanilla…

 
 
[]And give it a final mix.

 
 
[]Now, to turn the cookies into chocolate wonders, sift together flour,
cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.

 
 
[]Sing it with me, brothers and sisters: “Love sifted me! Love sifted
me! When nothing else could help, love sifted me!”

Ugh, I love old hymns. They are everything. (When sung correctly.)

 
 
[]Add the dry mixture a cup or so at a time, mixing after each addition…

 
 
[]Until it’s all added in…

 
 
[]And the dough looks like this.

My word.

 
 
[]I’m obsessed with these! They carry them in my small-town grocery
store right alongside the regular ol’ chocolate chips and I love them.

(Pssst. The milk chocolate chips are oversized and they make a nice
treat whenever you need a little chocolate hit.)

(And I need a little chocolate hit several times a day.)

 
 
[]For these cookies, I’m doing a combo of semi-sweet chips…

 
 
[]And milk chocolate chips.

(The milk chocolate sweetens the cookies a bit, so if you’re looking for
a super deep chocolate experience, use semi-sweet for the full amount.)

 
 
[]I’m going to entitle this photo “I Am Going to Lick This.”

Alternate title: “I Am Going to Like This.”

 
 
[]I used a cookie scoop but didn’t level it off, so I’d say each cookie
was a heaping tablespoon or so.

 
 
[]Scoop ’em onto a cookie sheet (or sheets, if you want to bake them all
at once.)

 
 
[]Then I like to press 2 or 3 chocolate chips into the top before they
go into the oven. Milk chocolate if you like things sweeter, semi-sweet
if you like things more chocolaty, both if you like…well, both!

 
 
[]The secret to these cookies is not to overbake them. You’ll want to
take them out of the oven when you’re not 100% sure they’re done. That
will ensure they’re perfect!

 
 
[]Unabashedly chocolicious!

 
 
[]Oh, and one thing I forgot to mention: A glass of milk is definitely
required for these suckers.

 
 
[DSC_3639-Recovered]Enjoy every bite!

Here’s the handy dandy printable.

 

Recipe

[]

Triple Chocolate Cookies

February 1, 2016 0

Prep Time:
    15 Minutes

Difficulty:
    Easy

Cook Time:
    10 Minutes

Servings:
    36 Servings

Ingredients

-   2-1/2 sticks Butter, Softened
-   2 cups Sugar
-   2 whole Large Eggs
-   3 teaspoons Vanilla Extract
-   2-1/4 cups All-purpose Flour
-   3/4 cups Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
-   1-1/2 teaspoon Baking Soda
-   1 teaspoon Salt
-   1-1/4 cup Milk Chocolate Chips
-   1-1/4 cup Good Semi Sweet Chocolate Chips

Instructions

Preheat oven to 350°F.
Using a mixer, cream butter and sugar until fluffy, scraping the sides
once.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing after each addition. Mix in vanilla.
Sift together dry ingredients, then add in batches to the mixer, mixing
until just combined after each addition.
Gently blend in chocolate chips, reserving a few for the tops of the
cookies
Using a cookie scoop, add generous 1 tablespoon portions to baking
sheet. Dot the top of each cookie with 2 to 3 chocolate chips if you’d
like them to really show up on top. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until
cookies are barely done but still soft and chewy. (Don't overbake!)
Let cool on a baking rack. Yummy!

EASY GLUTEN FREE CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES


By Liz DellaCroce 39 Comments

 Pin

 Share

 Tweet

 Stumble

_Chewy, nutty gluten free chocolate chip cookies are made with almond
flour and oat flour._

[Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Cookies - The Lemon Bowl]

Whether you follow a strict gluten free diet or not, these chocolate
chip cookies will be a hit with the whole family. Soft and chewy with
the perfect salty sweet balance, they satisfy every chocolate chip
cookie craving in the book.

The good news? For less than 100 calories a piece, these cookies fit in
perfectly with all of those healthy habits we’ve been working hard to
maintain. ;-)
We are not a gluten free household but I recently discovered a love for
baking with almond flour when I created Almond Flour Berry Muffins. The
subtle almond flavor is a match made in heaven for chocolate and
walnuts.

[Cookies on Silpat - The Lemon Bowl]

TIP: Cookies will have a softer consistency than you may be used to when
baking with wheat or white flour. Additionally, the batter is thick so I
recommend using your fingers to flatten the dough a bit before baking.

[Cookie Thief - The Lemon Bowl]

One last word of caution: keep an eye out for cookie thieves! They are
everywhere!

4.67 from 3 votes

[Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Cookies - The Lemon Bowl]

Print

Easy Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Cookies

Prep Time

10 mins

Cook Time

12 mins

Total Time

22 mins

 

Chewy, nutty gluten free chocolate chip cookies are made with almond
flour and oat flour.

Course: Dessert

Servings: 36

Calories: 95 kcal

Author: Liz DellaCroce

Ingredients

-   2 1/2 cups almond flour
-   1 cup oats gluten free
-   1/2 teaspoon baking powder
-   1/2 teaspoon salt
-   1 egg
-   1/4 cup white sugar
-   1/4 cup brown sugar packed
-   4 tablespoons softened butter unsalted
-   1/2 cup natural apple sauce
-   1 teaspoon vanilla
-   1/2 cup chocolate chips
-   1/2 cup chopped walnuts optional

US Measurements - Convert to Metric

Instructions

1.  Pre-heat the oven to 350 degrees and line several baking sheets with
    silicone baking sheets or parchment; set aside.

2.  In a food processor or blender, puree the oats to create oat flour
    then place in a medium bowl.

3.  Whisk together oat flour, almond flour, baking powder and salt; set
    aside.

4.  In a stand mixer on medium-high speed, cream together butter and
    sugar until smooth - about 2 minutes. With the mixer on medium, add
    egg, vanilla and apple sauce. Mix until smooth using a rubber
    spatula to scrape down the sides as you go.

5.  Over medium speed, slowly add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix
    until all ingredients are incorporated (being careful not to over
    mix.)

6.  Remove bowl from stand mixer and stir in chocolate chips and
    walnuts.

7.  Using a small cookie scoop or two tablespoons, drop the cookies on
    to the lined baking sheets being careful not to crowd.

8.  Bake for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned. Let cool completely
    before removing from the baking sheet.

Recipe Notes

Cookies will be soft and chewy with a subtle nutty flavor.

# 油焖大虾的做法

这道鲁菜经典以咸甜交融的酱汁包裹整虾，成菜红亮油润，虾肉紧实弹嫩。虾本身富含优质蛋白与虾青素，脂肪含量低，是补充营养又不易增加负担的食材。制作时需要炼葱油、剪虾、焖烧、收汁，对火候和调味把握有一定要求，更适合有基础的厨友尝试，全程大约需要 40 分钟。

预估烹饪难度：★★★★

预估卡路里：584 大卡

## 必备原料和工具

- 黑虎虾 or 明虾、
- 葱、姜
- 料酒、盐、冰糖、植物油

## 计算

 1 人食用的版本。

- 虾 10 只
- 花椒 5g
- 葱 50g
- 姜 20g
- 黄酒 30g
- 盐 3g
- 冰糖 10g
- 植物油

## 操作

1. 剪虾枪到根上，虾须虾爪都剪掉，沙包挑掉，开背虾线挑出来，洗净备用
2. 炸料油

  - 油温三成热放花椒，油热离火，放葱姜（不要让油变色最好）葱稍微变黄沥油 （葱油弄多了可以留着作为拌面使用）。

3. 下油，虾摆放整齐，两面变色后轻轻摁虾头

  - 放姜米（姜切成细颗粒）
  - 黄酒 30g
  - 水两小碗
  - 盐 3g
  - 冰糖 10 克

4. 大火烧开转小火盖盖子闷（中途不能再加汤水，不要开盖）
5. 皮亮虾弯就可以起锅，虾摆盘
6. 收汁（过滤后倒回锅里收浓，放葱油 ） 汤汁剩余 1/4 时。
7. 浇汁
8. 完成
9. ![油焖大虾-预览图-1](./油焖大虾.jpg)
10. 开吃✅

# Shrimp burgers

## Patties

In a small bowl, thoroughly combine:

- 3/4 teaspoon **kosher salt**
- 1/5 teaspoon **baking soda**
- 1/2 teaspoon **black pepper**
- 1/2 teaspoon **smoked paprika**
- 1/2 teaspoon **garlic powder**
- 1 teaspoon **lemon zest**
- 1 teaspoon **Dijon mustard**
- 1 tablespoon **mayo**
- 2 teaspoons **lemon juice**
- 1/3 cup **breadcrumbs**
- 1/2 teaspoon **anchovy paste**

In the bowl of a food processor, add 20% of the shrimp, and run until a shrimp paste forms:

- 1.5 lb raw large **shrimp**, peeled, deveined
- Binder mix

Then, add the remaining shrimp and pulse until the desired final texture is achieved.

Form into six 4oz patties. Chill 15–30 minutes for binding.

## Lemon-herb mayo

Whisk together:

- 1/2 cup **mayo**
- 1 tablespoon **lemon juice**
- 1 teaspoon **Dijon mustard**
- 1 tablespoon minced **parsley** or **chives**
- Salt

## To prepare

Heat oil and butter on a griddle over medium heat until shimmering:

- 1 tablespoon **neutral oil**
- 1 tablespoon **unsalted butter**

Sear patties ~3 minutes per side until golden and internal temp hits 145 F.

Rest and assemble with:

- Toasted **potato buns**
- **Lettuce**
- **Tomato**
- **Pickles**
- Lemon-herb mayo

---
title: Smoked Barbecue Spiced Cashews
description: Perfectly roasted cashews coated in a homemade barbecue spice blend featuring smoked paprika, cumin, and heat from cayenne. The spices toast alongside the nuts, creating an irresistible snack with deep, smoky flavor and satisfying crunch.
date: 2025-12-27
imgSrc: /assets/img/smoked-barbecue-cashews.jpg
imgAlt: Smoked Barbecue Spiced Cashews
prepTime: 8 min
readyTime: 30 min
servings: about 2 cups
tags:
  - Gluten-Free
  - Vegetarian
ingredients:
  - 2 cups raw whole cashews (about 9 ounces)
  - 1½ tablespoons unsalted butter
  - 1½ teaspoons smoked paprika
  - ¾ teaspoon garlic powder
  - ½ teaspoon onion powder
  - ½ teaspoon light brown sugar
  - ½ teaspoon cumin
  - ¼ teaspoon dry mustard powder
  - ½ teaspoon cayenne
  - 1½ teaspoons flaky sea salt
instructions:
  - Heat oven to 325°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment.
  - Melt the butter. Toss cashews in the butter until evenly coated.
  - Combine all spices and salt in a small bowl. Gradually sprinkle over cashews, tossing continuously until every nut is coated.
  - Spread in a single layer on the baking sheet. Roast for 14 minutes, stirring once at 7 minutes. Done when matte, deeply aromatic, and slightly darkened. They'll still feel soft.
  - Remove from oven and toss.
  - Cool completely on the sheet for 30 minutes. They crisp as they cool.
  - Gently shake off excess powder if there's too much.
  - Store in an airtight container for up to 10 days.
notes:
  - The cashews will feel soft when hot but crisp up completely as they cool.
  - Stir at the 7-minute mark to ensure even roasting and prevent burning.
  - Adjust cayenne to taste for more or less heat.
---

## The Art of Spiced Nuts

This barbecue spice blend draws inspiration from classic American barbecue seasonings, combining the smokiness of paprika with the warmth of cumin and the subtle heat of cayenne. The butter helps the spices adhere while contributing richness that balances the bold flavors.

The key to perfect spiced cashews is patience. While they may feel soft straight from the oven, resist the temptation to continue roasting. The nuts crisp beautifully as they cool, and over-roasting will result in a bitter taste.

## Why This Spice Blend Works

The combination of spices creates layers of flavor:

- **Smoked Paprika**: Provides the signature smoky backbone
- **Garlic & Onion Powder**: Add savory depth
- **Cumin**: Brings earthy warmth
- **Dry Mustard**: Contributes subtle tanginess
- **Cayenne**: Delivers gentle heat that builds
- **Brown Sugar**: Balances the spices with subtle sweetness
- **Flaky Sea Salt**: Enhances all flavors and adds texture

## Serving Suggestions

These versatile spiced cashews are perfect for:

- **Happy Hour**: Serve alongside cocktails or cold beer
- **Game Day**: A crowd-pleasing snack for gatherings
- **Cheese Boards**: Add to charcuterie plates for contrast
- **Gift Giving**: Package in mason jars for homemade gifts
- **Trail Mix**: Combine with dried fruit and dark chocolate

## Variations

### Extra Smoky
Double the smoked paprika and add ¼ teaspoon liquid smoke to the melted butter.

### Sweet Heat
Increase brown sugar to 1 tablespoon and cayenne to ¾ teaspoon.

### Ranch Style
Replace cumin with dried dill and add ½ teaspoon dried chives.

# Creami

## Strawberry ice cream

In a large bowl, add and mash:

- 8 ounces **fresh strawberries**, trimmed, cut in quarters
- 1/2 cup **sugar**
- 1 teaspoon **light corn syrup**
- 1 teaspoon **lemon juice**

Allow mixture to sit for 10 minutes, stirring regularly.

Add, and mix until well combined:

- 1 cup **heavy cream**

Transfer to storage cup and freeze for 24 hours.

Process on _ICE CREAM_ with the _CREAMi_ paddle.

## Frosted Lemonade Ice Cream

Blend with an immersion blender in a storage cup:

- 14 ounces **Premier Protein shake (vanilla)**
- 1 tablespoon **lemon instant pudding mix**
- 2 teaspoons **lemon zest**

Freeze for 24 hours.

Select _SCOOP_, and process on _CREAMIFIT_ with the _Creamerizer_ paddle.

## Berry sorbet

Add to CREAMi pint, firmly pressing down:

- 3 cups **mixed fruit**

Freeze for 24 hours.

Install _Creamerizer_ paddle, and process on _SORBET_.

## Vanilla gelato

Place into a small saucepan and whisk until fully combined and sugar is dissolved:

- 4 large **egg yolks**
- 1 tablespoon **light corn syrup**
- 1/4 cup + 1 tablespoon **sugar**

Add and stir to combine:

- 1 cup **heavy cream**
- 2/3 cup **whole milk**
- 1 whole **vanilla bean**, split in half lengthwise, scraped

Place saucepan on stove over medium heat, stirring constantly with a rubber spatula. Cook until temperature reaches 165-175 F.

Remove from heat, and transfer to CREAMi pint (optionally, strain).

Freeze for 24 hours.

Install _Creamerizer_ paddle and process on _GELATO_.

## Triple chocolate ice cream

In a microwave-safe bowl, add:

- 1 tablespoon **cream cheese**
- 2 tablespoons **cocoa powder**

Microwave for 10 seconds. Add and mix to combine until the mixture looks like frosting:

- 1/3 cup **sugar**
- 1 teaspoon **vanilla extract**

Slowly add and mix until fully combined and dissolved:

- 3/4 cup **heavy cream**
- 1 cup **whole milk**

Transfer to CREAMi pint, and freeze for 24 hours.

Install _Creamerizer_ paddle, and process on _ICE CREAM_.

Create a hole through the center of the pint, and add:

- 2 tablespoons **mini chocolate chips**
- 2 tablespoons **brownie chunks**

Process on _MIX-IN_.

## Cookies & cream

In a microwave-safe bowl, add:

- 1 tablespoon **cream cheese**

Microwave for 10 seconds. Add and mix to combine until the mixture looks like frosting:

- 1/3 cup **granulated sugar**
- 1 teaspoon **vanilla extract**

Slowly add and mix until fully combined and dissolved:

- 3/4 cup **heavy cream**
- 1 cup **whole milk**

Transfer to CREAMi pint, and freeze for 24 hours.

Install _Creamerizer_ paddle, and process on _ICE CREAM_.

Create a hole through the center of the pint, and add:

- 3 **Oreos**

[BEST Chocolate Chip Cookie recipe - so soft, so chewy and so delicious!
Everyone loves this recipe because these cookies are irresistible!]

Chocolate Chip Cookies seem to be the answer to every problem. Am I
right??? We tend to have lots of cookies at our family functions but
it’s because you can never go wrong with cookies, especially of the
chocolate chip variety!! Everyone loves them and it’s a treat that can
be made and enjoyed all year long. For the longest time, we’ve relied on
our classic chocolate chip cookie recipe, but we have ventured out and
tried other versions. We recently came across a new recipe that has
become our new go to cookie, and we wanted to share it with you today.

Now, we understand everyone claims to have the best chocolate chip
cookie recipe, but we think this one is pretty close. They are a little
crunchy on the outside, super soft on the inside and filled with so much
delicious-ness. The recipe calls for dissolving the baking soda in water
before adding it to the dough, and although we don’t know the exact
science behind this, we think this helps make them so magical.

[best chocolate chip cookie recipe]

As you could guess, the dough is so yummy and could be eaten all by
itself. It has more brown sugar than white sugar, and is filled with
milk chocolate chips.

I can promise you this – make these cookies for your friends, neighbors,
or family and they will love you forever. They are definitely sure to
brighten up anyone’s day!

Ingredients

-   1 cup butter, softened
-   ½ cup white sugar
-   1 ½ cups packed brown sugar
-   2 eggs
-   2 teaspoons vanilla extract
-   3 cups all-purpose flour
-   1 teaspoon baking soda
-   2 teaspoons hot water
-   ½ teaspoon salt
-   2 cups milk chocolate chips
-   1 cup chopped walnuts (optional)

Instructions

1.  Preheat oven to 350.
2.  Cream together butter, sugar, and brown sugar until smooth in mixer.
3.  Add eggs one at a time and mix well. Add vanilla.
4.  Dissolve baking soda in hot water and add to batter. Add salt,
    flour, and chocolate chips and mix until blended.
5.  Use cookie scoop to add to cookie sheets. Bake for 9-10 minutes.

instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat shortening and butter with an electric
mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Add brown sugar,

From the Test Kitchen
Giant Chocolate Chip Cookies:
Prepare as directed, except use a 1/4-cup dry measure or scoop to drop
mounds of dough about 4 inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in a 375 degree F oven for 11 to 13 minutes or until edges are
lightly browned. Makes about 20 cookies.
Macadamia Nut and White Chocolate Cookies:
Prepare as directed, except substitute chopped white baking bars or
white chocolate baking squares for the semisweet chocolate pieces. Stir
in one 3-1/2-ounce jar macadamia nuts, chopped, with the chopped white
baking bars or squares.
Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars:
Prepare as directed, except press dough into an ungreased 15x10x1-inch
baking pan. Bake in a 375 degree F oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until
golden. Cool in pan on a wire rack. Cut into bars. Makes 48 bars.

ingredients: 30 squares good-quality chocolate (milk, white or plain)
Happy Days with the Naked Chef
instructions: This is a great recipe to make with kids as a treat, as it’s very
simple and good fun putting the top circle over the chocolate and
squashing the edges gently together to stop the chocolate escaping
when it cooks.
This is quite a dry mixture, but don’t worry, they are meant to look
a bit cracked and rustic, so you can’t really go wrong! If you eat
these when they have just been cooked the chocolate is quite runny,
and if you eat them cold they are nice and gooey. You’ll need two
cutters, one about 4cm and the other about 5cm.
Grease a large baking sheet. Cream the butter and sugar together
until pale. Beat in the egg yolks, then add the flour and cocoa
powder to make a dough. Turn out and knead, then pop it into the
fridge for a while. Preheat the oven to 190ºC/375ºF/gas 5.
On a lightly floured surface, roll about a third of the dough out
thinly, then cut out about 30 circles with the smaller cutter (you
can do fewer if you want the biscuits bigger). Spread them out on
the baking sheet and put a square of chocolate in the middle of each
one – make sure you use all the chocolate however many you do. Then
roll the rest of the dough out (I always add the leftovers from the
first lot of cutting to it and knead it a bit). Cut out the same
number of circles with the larger cutter and pop them on top of the
chocolate, pressing gently all the way round to seal the edge and
keep all the chocolate in.
Cook in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, and eat them hot or cold.

# Pasta carbonara

![Pasta carbonara](https://i.imgur.com/K1G6Gao.jpg)
![Plain pasta carbonara](https://i.imgur.com/j4WpFM0.jpg)

> Serves 2.

Whisk in a small bowl:

- 2 large egg yolks, room temperature
- 30 grams grated pecorino Romano (or Parmesan, or a blend)
- Coarsely ground black pepper

In a pan over medium-low heat, gently saute until slightly crispy (~10 minutes):

- 1/2 tablespoon olive oil
- 50 grams pancetta, sliced into 1/4" cubes

Saute until fragrant (~30 seconds):

- 2 cloves garlic, sliced thinly

Toss to coat, form a sauce (~1 minute), and remove from the heat:

- 170 grams spaghetti (or fettucini, or linguine), cooked al dente
- 1/4 cup pasta water

When it has cooled enough to not scramble the eggs, toss to coat with:

- Egg & cheese mixture

Garnish and serve immediately:

- Black pepper
- Parmesan, optional
- Parsley, optional
- Lemon zest, optional
- Nutmeg, freshly grated, optional

raw_text:
# 荔枝肉的做法

荔枝肉是一道酸甜酥香的福州传统闽菜，外焦里嫩的肉块裹着红亮的酱汁，搭配水果添入清爽果香。猪瘦肉富含优质蛋白质，凤梨含有膳食纤维和维生素，能帮助开胃解腻。制作过程需要切肉、挂糊和两次油炸，略有挑战但步骤明确，适合有一定下厨基础的美食爱好者尝试，大约 45 分钟就能端上餐桌。

预估烹饪难度：★★★★

预估卡路里：681 大卡

## 必备原料和工具

* 瘦肉
* 凤梨
* 鸡蛋
* 食用油
* 白砂糖
* 淀粉
* 生抽
* 鸡精
* 姜末
* 芝麻
* 番茄酱
* 香醋

## 计算

每份：

* 鲜香菇 2 朵
* 蟹味菇 30 g
* 瘦肉 150 g
* 凤梨 100 g
* 鸡蛋 1 个
* 食用油 500 ml
* 白砂糖 5 g
* 淀粉 100 g
* 生抽 5 ml
* 鸡精 5 g
* 姜末 5 g
* 芝麻 2 g
* 番茄酱 20 g
* 香醋 2 ml

## 操作

1. 瘦肉切块（每块 2-3 cm ），放入大碗中，加入鸡蛋 1 个 、生粉 50 g 、生抽 3 ml 、鸡精 2 g
2. 充分搅拌，直至生粉包裹住瘦肉块（太稀则继续加生粉，太干则加水），然后加入 5 ml 油，在充分搅拌后备用
3. 在准备一个碗，加入番茄酱、鸡精 3 g 、生抽 2 ml 、姜末、白砂糖、生粉 10 g \香醋、凉水 200 ml ,充分搅拌后备用
4. 切一个凤梨, 准备 6 个 （每个 1.5-2 cm）凤梨块
5. 起锅烧油，倒入 500 ml 油，一直烧油直到听到油炸声
6. 将瘦肉一个一个放入锅中（切记不可以整碗倒入），保证每个肉不要粘在一起
7. 全部放入瘦肉后，每 30 S 用勺子来回两面翻转瘦肉块，直至瘦肉块表面金黄
8. 取出瘦肉，一分钟后倒入油锅中继续炸，直至瘦肉块表面出现焦黄后，取出放入大碗备用
9. 起锅，倒入汤汁，30 S 后倒入瘦肉块、凤梨块，充分翻炒后 出锅
10. 摆上芝麻

![荔枝肉-预览图-2](./2.jpeg)
![荔枝肉-预览图-3](./3.jpeg)
![荔枝肉-预览图-4](./4.jpeg)

## 附加内容

* 更多情况下，福州当地会选用马蹄（解腻）和马铃薯（洗油），因为疫情期间买不到，所以选用了凤梨
* 闽菜以甜为主，如果吃不惯的可以放弃白糖
* 可以通过勺子敲打瘦肉块，听到声响来判断是否炸透瘦肉

description: California za'atar recipe - fresh herb and olive oil dip with sesame, thyme, oregano, and lemon. Perfect for flatbread, grilled meats, or roasted vegetables.

imgSrc: /assets/img/za'atar.jpg
imgAlt: Za'atar

ingredients:
  - ¼ cup sesame seeds
  - 1 garlic clove
  - ¼ cup dried thyme
  - ¼ cup dried oregano
  - 1 tsp finely grated lemon zest
  - 2 tsp ground sumac (optional)
  - 1 cup extra-virgin olive oil
  - Kosher salt
instructions:
  - Toast sesame seeds in a dry frying pan over medium heat until fragrant and beginning to brown, about 3 minutes. Let cool.
  - Using a microplane, grate the garlic into a small bowl. Add thyme, oregano, toasted sesame seeds, lemon zest, sumac (if using), and olive oil. Stir to combine and season with salt.
  - Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.
notes:
  - Makes 1.25 cups of za'atar oil.
  - The optional sumac adds a tangy flavor - adjust to taste.
  - Perfect for dipping flatbread or drizzling over grilled meats and vegetables.
---

## What is Za'atar?

Za'atar is a Middle Eastern spice blend that has been used for thousands of years, with variations found across Lebanon, Syria, Jordan, Palestine, Israel, and other countries in the region. Traditional za'atar typically contains dried thyme, oregano, marjoram, sumac, sesame seeds, and salt, though exact proportions and additional ingredients vary by region and family recipe.

This California-inspired version maintains the core elements of traditional za'atar while incorporating ingredients that reflect California's agricultural bounty and culinary influences - citrus zest adds brightness, while pistachios contribute a nutty depth that complements the herbal base.

## Culinary Uses

California Za'atar is incredibly versatile and can be used in countless ways:

- **Olive Oil Dip**: Mix with good olive oil for bread dipping
- **Vegetable Seasoning**: Sprinkle on roasted vegetables before or after cooking
- **Protein Rub**: Use as a dry rub for chicken, fish, or tofu
- **Yogurt Mix-in**: Stir into plain yogurt for a quick dip or sauce
- **Avocado Toast**: Sprinkle on avocado toast for a flavor boost
- **Hummus Topping**: Dust over hummus for color and flavor
- **Grain Bowls**: Add to rice, quinoa, or other grain dishes
- **Salad Enhancer**: Mix into salad dressings or sprinkle directly on salads

## About the Ingredients

### Sumac
A deep red spice with a tart, lemony flavor that's essential to za'atar. It comes from grinding the dried berries of the sumac bush.

### Pistachios
A California twist on the traditional blend, adding richness and a subtle sweetness that balances the tangy sumac.

### Dried Citrus Zest
Another California-inspired addition that amplifies the citrus notes of the sumac while adding a distinctive brightness.

### Aleppo Pepper
Named after the Syrian city of Aleppo, these mild, fruity chili flakes add a gentle heat and complexity.

## Variations

### Traditional Za'atar
Omit the pistachios, citrus zest, and Aleppo pepper for a more traditional Middle Eastern blend.

### Spicy California Za'atar
Double the Aleppo pepper and add 1/4 teaspoon cayenne for a blend with more heat.

### Herbal-Forward Za'atar
Increase the thyme, oregano, and marjoram, and add 1 tablespoon dried mint for an even more aromatic blend.
title: California Za'atar

ingredients: 1 płaska łyżka masła orzechowego lub nutelli
120 g groszków czekoladowych lub (posiekane 80 g czekolady mlecznej, 40 g gorzkiej)
instructions: Krok 1 Miękkie masło (200 g) miksujemy z cukrem (160 g) przez 1-2 minuty aż masa zrobi się puszysta.
Krok 2 Dodajemy stopniowo po jednym jajku, cały czas miksując.
Krok 3 Wsypujemy mąkę pszenną (320 g), proszek do pieczenia (1 łyżeczka) i kakao (60 g). Dodajemy także masło orzechowe lub nutellę (1 płaska łyżka). Całość lekko mieszamy za pomocą łyżki.

Krok 4 Na sam koniec dodajemy groszki czekoladowe (120 g) lub drobno posiekaną czekoladę (ja wymieszałam mleczną lub gorzką). Łyżkę posiekanej czekolady czy groszków zwykle odstawiam na bok i wkładam je w uformowane już ciasteczka. Zagniatamy dłonią gładkie ciasto.
Krok 5 Z ciasta formujemy długi rulonik i wycinamy kawałki w równych odstępach. Powinno wyjść około 20-24 ciastek średniej wielkości.

Krok 6 Formujemy ciasteczka i układamy równomiernie na foremce wyłożonej papierem do pieczenia. Na ich wierzchu wbijamy po 3-4 kosteczki posiekanej czekolady. Piec przez 10-12 minut w temp. 190 stopni (góra-dół). Długość pieczenia zależy głównie od wielkości uformowanych ciastek. Nie polecam ich piec zbyt długo, bo najsmaczniejsze są po około 10 minutach pieczenia. Zaraz po wyciągnięciu z piekarnika mogą wydawać się niedopieczone, lecz po chwili zastygają (można je bez problemu odkleić od papieru, nie kruszą się, ani nic w tym stylu). Smacznego!

	<div class="recipe-desc">
				<div>
			<p><strong>Ciasteczka czekoladowe</strong> to coś naprawdę pysznego! Rozpływają się w ustach… Uwierzcie mi na słowo. Już po jednym kęsie masz ochotę na kolejne i kolejne… Do kawki jak znalazł! Te ciastka czekoladowe uwielbiane są przez dzieci jak i dorosłych. Ogólnie nie znam osoby, której by nie smakowały…</p>
<h3>Przepis na ciasteczka czekoladowe</h3>
<p>Ten przepis na ciasteczka czekoladowe nie powinien Ci sprawić żadnych trudności. Ich przygotowanie opisałam wraz ze zdjęciami krok po kroku. Dlatego jestem pewna, że wyjdą Ci idealne już za pierwszym podejściem. Domowe ciasteczka czekoladowe wychodzą naprawdę super smaczne. Wystarczy, że zrobisz je raz to przepadniesz… Serio! Są kruchutkie, maślane i mocno czekoladowe.</p>
<p>Jeżeli lubisz takie kruche, maślane ciasteczka to koniecznie wypróbuj te przepisy:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/najlepszy-przepis-na-maslane-ciasteczka/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Najlepszy przepis na maślane ciasteczka >></a></li>
<li><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/czekoladowe-ciasteczka-z-orzechami/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Czekoladowe ciasteczka z orzechami >></a></li>
<li><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/czekoladowe-ciastka-z-maslem-orzechowym/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Czekoladowe ciastka z masłem orzechowym >></a></li>
</ul>

			<h2>Ciasteczka czekoladowe - przepis krok po kroku</h2>
<hr class="divider divider-normal">
<div class="step" id="step1" itemprop="recipeInstructions" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/HowToStep"><meta itemprop="position" content="1"><link itemprop="url" href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/przepis/ciasteczka-czekoladowe/#step1">
<div class="step-numb">
<p>Krok 1</p>
</div>
<div class="one_fourth steps-columns"><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka.jpg"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36089" title="ciasteczka czekoladowe z kawałkami czekolady" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20400%20600'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="kruche ciastka" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image" data-lazy-src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka.jpg"><noscript><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36089" title="ciasteczka czekoladowe z kawałkami czekolady" src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka.jpg" alt="kruche ciastka" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image"></noscript></a></p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
<div class="three_fourth steps-columns last" itemprop="text">Miękkie masło (200 g) miksujemy z cukrem (160 g) przez 1-2 minuty aż masa zrobi się puszysta.</p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
</div>
<hr class="divider divider-normal">
<div class="step" id="step2" itemprop="recipeInstructions" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/HowToStep"><meta itemprop="position" content="2"><link itemprop="url" href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/przepis/ciasteczka-czekoladowe/#step2">
<div class="step-numb">
<p>Krok 2</p>
</div>
<div class="one_fourth steps-columns"><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_1.jpg"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36079" title="ciasteczka kakaowe" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20400%20600'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="ciastka kakaowe" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image" data-lazy-src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_1.jpg"><noscript><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36079" title="ciasteczka kakaowe" src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_1.jpg" alt="ciastka kakaowe" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image"></noscript></a></p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
<div class="three_fourth steps-columns last" itemprop="text">Dodajemy stopniowo po jednym jajku, cały czas miksując. </p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
</div>
<hr class="divider divider-normal">
<div class="step" id="step3" itemprop="recipeInstructions" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/HowToStep"><meta itemprop="position" content="3"><link itemprop="url" href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/przepis/ciasteczka-czekoladowe/#step3">
<div class="step-numb">
<p>Krok 3</p>
</div>
<div class="one_fourth steps-columns"><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_2.jpg"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36080" title="kruche ciastka" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20400%20600'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="ciastka dla dzieci" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image" data-lazy-src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_2.jpg"><noscript><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36080" title="kruche ciastka" src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_2.jpg" alt="ciastka dla dzieci" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image"></noscript></a></p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
<div class="three_fourth steps-columns last" itemprop="text">Wsypujemy mąkę pszenną (320 g), proszek do pieczenia (1 łyżeczka) i kakao (60 g). Dodajemy także masło orzechowe lub nutellę (1 płaska łyżka). Całość lekko mieszamy za pomocą łyżki.</p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
</div>
<p><ins class="adsbygoogle" style="display:block; text-align:center;" data-ad-layout="in-article" data-ad-format="fluid" data-ad-client="ca-pub-3593415912301189" data-ad-slot="9331798911"></ins><script type="rocketlazyloadscript">(adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});</script></p>
<hr class="divider divider-normal">
<div class="step" id="step4" itemprop="recipeInstructions" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/HowToStep"><meta itemprop="position" content="4"><link itemprop="url" href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/przepis/ciasteczka-czekoladowe/#step4">
<div class="step-numb">
<p>Krok 4</p>
</div>
<div class="one_fourth steps-columns"><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_3.jpg"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36081" title="proste ciastka dla dzieci" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20400%20600'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="ciastka dla dzieci" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image" data-lazy-src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_3.jpg"><noscript><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36081" title="proste ciastka dla dzieci" src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_3.jpg" alt="ciastka dla dzieci" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image"></noscript></a></p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
<div class="three_fourth steps-columns last" itemprop="text">Na sam koniec dodajemy groszki czekoladowe (120 g) lub drobno posiekaną czekoladę (ja wymieszałam mleczną lub gorzką).</p>
<p>Łyżkę posiekanej czekolady czy groszków zwykle odstawiam na bok i wkładam je w uformowane już ciasteczka.</p>
<p>Zagniatamy dłonią gładkie ciasto.</p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="step" id="step5" itemprop="recipeInstructions" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/HowToStep"><meta itemprop="position" content="5"><link itemprop="url" href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/przepis/ciasteczka-czekoladowe/#step5">
<div class="step-numb">
<p>Krok 5</p>
</div>
<div class="one_fourth steps-columns"><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_4.jpg"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36082" title="jak zrobić ciasteczka czekoladowe" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20400%20600'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="ciastka czekoladowe" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image" data-lazy-src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_4.jpg"><noscript><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36082" title="jak zrobić ciasteczka czekoladowe" src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_4.jpg" alt="ciastka czekoladowe" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image"></noscript></a></p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
<div class="three_fourth steps-columns last" itemprop="text">Z ciasta formujemy długi rulonik i wycinamy kawałki w równych odstępach. Powinno wyjść około 20-24 ciastek średniej wielkości.</p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
</div>
<hr class="divider divider-normal">
<div class="step" id="step6" itemprop="recipeInstructions" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/HowToStep"><meta itemprop="position" content="6"><link itemprop="url" href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/przepis/ciasteczka-czekoladowe/#step6">
<div class="step-numb">
<p>Krok 6</p>
</div>
<div class="one_fourth steps-columns"><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_5.jpg"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36083" title="ciastka czekoladowe" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20400%20600'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="proste ciasteczka czekoladowe" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image" data-lazy-src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_5.jpg"><noscript><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36083" title="ciastka czekoladowe" src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_5.jpg" alt="proste ciasteczka czekoladowe" width="400" height="600" / itemprop="image"></noscript></a></p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
<div class="three_fourth steps-columns last" itemprop="text">Formujemy ciasteczka i układamy równomiernie na foremce wyłożonej papierem do pieczenia. Na ich wierzchu wbijamy po 3-4 kosteczki posiekanej czekolady.</p>
<p>Piec przez 10-12 minut w temp. 190 stopni (góra-dół). Długość pieczenia zależy głównie od wielkości uformowanych ciastek. Nie polecam ich piec zbyt długo, bo najsmaczniejsze są po około 10 minutach pieczenia. Zaraz po wyciągnięciu z piekarnika mogą wydawać się niedopieczone, lecz po chwili zastygają (można je bez problemu odkleić od papieru, nie kruszą się, ani nic w tym stylu). Smacznego!</p>
<div class="step-off-fader"></div>
</div>
</div>
<hr class="divider divider-normal">
<p><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_10.jpg"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36088 size-full" title="przepis na ciasteczka czekoladowe" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20667'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Ciasteczka czekoladowe" width="1000" height="667" data-lazy-src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_10.jpg" /><noscript><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36088 size-full" title="przepis na ciasteczka czekoladowe" src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_10.jpg" alt="Ciasteczka czekoladowe" width="1000" height="667" /></noscript></a></p>

<p><a href="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_9.jpg"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36087 size-full" title="proste ciasteczka czekoladowe" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20667%201000'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="szybkie ciasteczka czekoladowe" width="667" height="1000" data-lazy-src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_9.jpg" /><noscript><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-36087 size-full" title="proste ciasteczka czekoladowe" src="https://poprostupycha.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ciasteczka_9.jpg" alt="szybkie ciasteczka czekoladowe" width="667" height="1000" /></noscript></a></p>

		<div id="seo-box"><div class="seo-box-content"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Ciasteczka czekoladowe</h2>
<p>Lubisz szybkie przekąski na słodko? W takim razie koniecznie wypróbuj ten <strong>przepis na ciasteczka czekoladowe</strong>! Są naprawdę przepyszne i ciężko poprzestać na jednym 🙂 Do przepisu możemy czekoladę połamać, pokroić w kostkę lub użyć czekoladowych groszków. Możemy również użyć gorzką lub mleczną czekoladę, albo jedną i drugą. Ja najczęściej korzystam z tej ostatniej opcji, ale wszystko zależy od Twoich preferencji. W każdej wersji ciasteczka czekoladowe smakują rewelacyjne. Jestem przekonana, że jak raz ich spróbujesz, to ten przepis trafi na listę ulubionych wypieków i będziesz je robić bardzo często!</p>
<h3>Przepis na ciasteczka z czekoladą</h3>
<p>Ten<strong> przepis na ciasteczka z czekoladą </strong>są idealnym przepisem dla osób, które są fanami czekolady lub zaczynają swoją przygodę z pieczeniem. Ciasteczka z kawałkami czekolady docenią nie tylko dzieci, ale również dorośli. Są świetnym pomysłem na każdą okazję, zarówno jako dodatek do popołudniową kawusię, słodki dodatek na imprezę czy też jako smaczna przekąska, kiedy spodziewamy się gości i nie mamy za wiele czasu na przygotowanie czegoś do poczęstunku. Aby przygotować czekoladowe ciasteczka, potrzebować będziemy następujące składniki: masło, jajka, mąkę pszenną, kakao, masło orzechowe lub nutellę, proszek do pieczenia oraz czekoladę. Ważne, aby masło było miękkie, czyli w temperaturze pokojowej.</p>
<h2>Szybkie ciastka czekoladowe</h2>
<p>Te <strong>szybkie ciastka czekoladowe</strong> przygotujesz w zaledwie 20 minut, a uwierz mi, że warto! Nie trzeba tutaj przygotowywać ciasta kruchego i dawać go do lodówki na 2 godziny, dlatego te szybkie ciastka czekoladowe są super rozwiązaniem dla osób, które nie mają za dużo czasu na przygotowanie czegoś słodkiego. Zresztą sama często mam tak, że nachodzi mnie myśl, że zjadłabym co słodkiego, ale nie zawsze mam czas, aby przygotowywać skomplikowane dania. W takim przypadku bardzo chętnie sięgam po takie smakołyki. Z tego przepisu wychodzi około 24 ciasteczek, ale oczywiście wszystko zależy jak duże ciastka czekoladowe zrobisz.</p>
<p>Z reguły nie używam margaryny w swoich przepisach, jednak jeżeli nie masz żadnego masła pod ręką, to możesz je nią zastąpić. Tak samo sodę oczyszczoną możesz zastąpić proszkiem do pieczenia i na odwrót.</p>
<h3>Przepis na ciastka z czekoladą</h3>
<p>Wychodzę z założenia, że <strong>przepis na ciastka z czekoladą</strong> oraz ich sposób przygotowania ma być prosty i taki właśnie ten przepis jest! Zaczynamy od tego, że miękkie masło miksujemy z cukrem na puszystą masę, a następnie dodajemy po jednym jajku, cały czas mieszając. W kolejnym kroku dodajemy sypkie składniki, czyli mąkę, proszek do pieczenia i kakao. Uważam, że ciastka czekoladowe smakują jeszcze lepiej kiedy dodamy nutellę lub masło orzechowe, więc polecam również ich użyć. Mieszamy do połączenia się składników. Na tym etapie możesz dodać również posiekane orzechy, jeżeli masz ochotę.</p>
<p>Następnie dodaję czekoladę i ugniatam ręką ciasto. Potem formuję rulonik i wycinam mniej więcej równe kawałki. Formujemy z nich ciasteczka i układamy na blasze wyłożonej papierem do pieczenia, zachowując kilkucentymetrowe odstępy. Dodatkowo na wierzch możemy dodać kilka kawałków czekolady. Wstawiamy do rozgrzanego do 190 stopni piekarnika i pieczemy przez około 10 minut. Wiem, że będzie ciężko się powstrzymać, ale po upieczeniu najlepiej odczekać do całkowitego przestygnięcia, wtedy nasze ciasteczka czekoladowe będą najsmaczniejsze.</p>

Ingredients

-   2 cups (300 g) gluten-free all-purpose flour
-   ½ tsp baking soda
-   ½ tsp baking powder
-   1 cup (225 g) softened unsalted butter
-   1 cup (240 g) lightly packed brown sugar
-   1 egg
-   1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract
-   1 cup (200 g) chocolate chips, semi-sweet or milk chocolate

Select all Add to my grocery list Add to my grocery list


Preparation

1.  In a bowl, combine the flour, baking soda and baking powder. Set
    aside.
2.  In another bowl, cream the butter and brown sugar with an electric
    mixer. Add the egg and vanilla. Beat until smooth. With a wooden
    spoon, stir in the dry ingredients and chocolate chips.
3.  With a 2-tbsp (30 ml) ice cream scoop, shape the dough into balls.
    Refrigerate or freeze for 30 minutes.
4.  With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 375°F
    (190°C). Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
5.  Place 8 balls per prepared sheet, spacing them evenly. Freeze at
    this stage, if desired. Bake, one sheet at a time, for 8 to
    10 minutes or until lightly golden brown. Let cool on the baking
    sheets.


Note

Make sure cookies are baked through, otherwise they may turn out
brittle.

# Sushi rice

Rinse until the water runs clear:

- 1 cup **sushi rice**

Place the rice and water into a medium saucepan and bring to a boil:

- 1 cup **water**

Once it begins to boil, reduce the heat to the lowest setting and cover.

Cook for 15 minutes.

Remove from the heat and let stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, combine in a small sauce pan over medium heat, until sugar is dissolved, and immediately remove from heat:

- 1 piece of **konbu**, about 2 inch x 2 inch square
- 2 tablespoons **sugar**
- 4 tablespoons **rice vinegar**
- 1 teaspoon **kosher salt**

Transfer the seasoned vinegar into a small bowl to allow it to cool.

Spread the rice evenly into a casserole dish and add most of the vinegar mixture.

Fan the rice while gently folding to combine, seasoning to taste with remaining vinegar mixture.

Hold at room temperature with a piece of plastic wrap pressed against the surface until served.

WALNUT CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES


September 26, 2015 at 3:00 am.  |  18 Comments

[]

One batch of these Walnut Chocolate Chip cookies and they will become
your new favorite cookie!  You will love these rich and buttery cookies
loaded with chocolate chips and walnuts!!!  Pour yourself a glass of
milk and enjoy!!

 Six Sisters Stuff

Serves: 36

Walnut Chocolate Chip Cookies

You will love these soft and chewy cookies loaded with chocolate chips
and walnuts.

10 minPrep Time

12 minCook Time

22 minTotal Time

[Save Recipe]Save Recipe

Print Recipe

My Recipes My Lists My Calendar

Ingredients

-   1 cup butter, softened
-   1 cup brown sugar, packed
-   2/3 cup sugar
-   2 eggs, large
-   2 teaspoons vanilla extract
-   1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
-   2 3/4 cups flour
-   11.5 ounces milk chocolate chips
-   1 cup walnuts, chopped

Instructions

1.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2.  Beat butter, brown sugar, and sugar with hand mixer on medium speed
    for 2 minutes until mixture is very fluffy and turns lighter in
    color
3.  Beat in eggs, vanilla, and baking soda for 1 minute on low speed.
    Scrape the sides of bowl as needed.
4.  Gradually mix in flour just until blended. Stir in chocolate chips
    and walnuts.
5.  Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls and place on baking sheet. Bake until
    golden around the edges - about 11 to 13 minutes.
6.  Cool on cookie sheet for about 1 minute then transfer to a wire rack
    to finish cooling.

Protein-Packed Chocolate Chip Cookies

May 20, 2017 by Susi May

 252 Shares

Chat with us on Facebook Messenger. Learn what's trending across
POPSUGAR.

You will love this protein-packed take on the classic chocolate chip
cookie. Using only five ingredients, you can quickly whip up a batch of
these vegan cookies in no time. Watch the video to see how easy they are
to make.

[Guilt-Free Vegan Chocolate Chip Cookies ]


Guilt-Free Vegan Chocolate Chip Cookies 

From Lizzie Fuhr, POPSUGAR Fitness

[Guilt-Free Vegan Chocolate Chip Cookies]

Ingredients

1.  1 cup chickpeas, skins removed, patted dry
2.  1/3 cup natural peanut butter
3.  1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
4.  2 tablespoons agave nectar
5.  1/3 cup vegan chocolate chips

Directions

1.  Preheat oven to 350°F.
2.  Combine chickpeas, peanut butter, vanilla extract, and agave in a
    blender or food processor. Blend until it's a fine puree. Then fold
    in chocolate chips.
3.  Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray or line tray with
    parchment paper.
4.  Add spoonfuls of dough and flatten to form cookie shape on baking
    tray.
5.  Bake cookies for 10 minutes.
6.  Let cool and enjoy!
